name: Sallie Mae (SLM)
teaser: The market prices Sallie Mae as if its return on equity falls to about 20% for good. Base $25.40, eight days before the peak-season quarter.
llms: SLM Corporation (Sallie Mae) is the largest US private student lender, funded by Sallie Mae Bank deposits and a loan sale partnership with KKR. Valued with residual income on common equity after preferred stock and a forward earnings cross-check. At $22.70 the price implies a permanent return on equity of about 20.5% against more than 30% earned in each of the last three years. Bear $13.66, Base $25.40, Bull $35.05. Verdict Hold at $22.70, maximum buy price $13.97.
